Alzheimer disease.notes: AChE inhibitors approved; mTOR/AMPK pathways under investigation for repurposing

Type 2 diabetes.notes: SGLT2 inhibitors and GLP-1 agonists are recent approvals with repurposing potential

Parkinson disease.notes: Nilotinib (CML drug) and GLP-1 agonists actively investigated for PD neuroprotection

Breast cancer.notes: ER+ and HER2+ targeted therapies; metformin and aspirin in multiple clinical trials

Lung cancer.notes: EGFR and ALK inhibitors; immunotherapy now standard; repurposing targets angiogenesis and mTOR

COVID-19.notes: Dexamethasone was a rapid repurposing success; IL-6 pathway drugs baricitinib/tocilizumab approved

Rheumatoid arthritis.notes: TNF and JAK inhibitors are mainstays; HCQ repurposed from antimalarial

Depression.notes: Ketamine (anesthetic) rapidly approved as esketamine for TRD — landmark repurposing success

Hypertension.notes: Minoxidil repurposed from antihypertensive to hair loss; sildenafil from hypertension to ED

Asthma.notes: IL-5 pathway biologic mepolizumab repurposed from eosinophilic conditions

Influenza.notes: Favipiravir (originally for RNA viruses) repurposed for influenza and COVID-19

HIV infection.notes: Combination ART remains standard; NRTI/NNRTI/PI classes well established

Multiple myeloma.notes: Thalidomide is the canonical drug repurposing story — from sedative to myeloma drug

Colorectal cancer.notes: Aspirin has strong epidemiological evidence for CRC prevention — classic repurposing candidate

Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.notes: Azithromycin repurposed from antibiotic to COPD maintenance therapy (anti-inflammatory)
